title: ShadowRunReport.v1
description: The result of running a RuleCandidate in SHADOW mode alongside the live (LLM/human/deterministic-authority) path on real traffic: the rule's output is RECORDED but NOT used (non_authoritative pinned true) and compared to the actually-served decision. It is the M6 evidence the gate reads after replay: agreements, total mismatches, and the SAFETY counter unsafe_mismatch_count — a shadow case where the rule would have served a WRONG fact had it been live; ANY unsafe mismatch blocks promotion. Like replay it compares only against verified served decisions and never crosses tenant boundaries (tenant_leak_count must be 0). Deterministic when created_at is injected.

live_decisions_observed.description: number of live decisions the shadow rule ran alongside

agreements.description: shadow rule's output matched the served decision

mismatches.description: shadow rule's output differed from the served decision (includes safe abstentions/disagreements)

unsafe_mismatch_count.description: mismatches where the rule would have served a WRONG fact had it been live; ANY > 0 BLOCKS promotion

tenant_leak_count.description: shadow decisions that crossed a tenant boundary; MUST be 0

non_authoritative.description: structurally pinned true: the shadow rule's output was recorded, never served

observed_trace_ids.description: the live trace ids observed (lossless link)

unsafe_mismatch_trace_ids.description: trace ids of unsafe mismatches; present even if empty so a non-zero count is auditable
